C.note: Reports the exact differing bytes between two memory ranges

D.note: Displays entered, filled, moved, and loaded bytes in hexadecimal and ASCII

E.note: Writes exact byte sequences consumed by dump and real execution

F.note: Fills a memory range with a verified repeated byte

G.note: Executes assembled code, emits its exact payload, and catches normal INT 20h termination

H.note: Reports exact hexadecimal sum and difference results

M.note: Copies an exact memory range to a separately dumped destination

N.note: Supplies the filename used by exact load and write contracts

O.note: Writes byte 41h to QEMU's E9h debug port and captures exactly A

P.note: Proceeds over one NOP and reports the exact next instruction pointer

Q.note: Returns from redirected DEBUG sessions and allows the calling batch to continue

R.note: Displays registers and changes AX and IP to exact requested values

S.note: Finds an exact byte pattern at its expected address

T.note: Single-steps MOV AX,1234 and reports the resulting AX and IP

U.note: Disassembles source-assembled NOP and INT 20h instructions

W.note: Writes the requested five bytes to a named file verified byte-for-byte

X.note: Dispatches every live EMS subcommand against EMM386

A.note: Allocates one EMS page and reports the created handle

D.note: Deallocates the created EMS handle and reports it

M.note: Maps logical page zero to physical page zero for the created handle

S.note: Reports live EMS page-frame, allocation, and handle state
